title: Repeat the words you want to believe
header_line: My analysis of one book on neuro-linguistic programming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What do you tell yourself before the start?
I said that I learned to repeat to myself: I am confident, I will train hard, I will go to the state meet. I learned repetition, because in swimming you follow the black line up and down.
I said that you can repeat words like a rhythm so that they become the voice you hear instead of the old one.
Write the three sentences you will repeat each morning and where you will say them.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write where you will say them.
Write the old sentence they replace.
Write how long you will do it.
Write who will check on you.

check.q: What did I learn to do in swimming?
What did I say repetition replaces?
Where did I say you follow a black line?

recap: Repeat the words you want to believe.
